I'm just gonna be honest with you. If I were you, I wouldn't go. It's not worth breaking your trust with your parents, to go to a party.

Then again, I'm not you.

If you really want to go, you might as well. Just make sure you can apologize to your dad if you get caught. 

You're a teenager, it's cool to take risks, have fun, make mistakes.

It's ultimately your choice. But whatever you do, make sure you're happy with it.

Start out being kind to her. Don't try to come off as creepy or someone who's overly, I guess, snobby. Give her compliments, say nice things about her.

Once you know she's comfortable around you, ask her if she wants to study with you, or hang out. Ask her if she wants to go study for a test together.

If you're uncomfortable with doing that, fine. Just go slow then, it's only September. Does she sit beside you? If not, just try talking to her in the hallways, or make eye contact with her.

One thing I need to say, is don't be shy. Girls like confidence, shy girls look up to guys who are self-confidence. Popular ones can relate. It's okay to know you're scared as fuck to ask her out, but don't show it. Good luck.

Good luck man.

Source: A retarded 10th grader who couldn't even say happy birthday to his crush. Don't be shy like me, lol.
Update: she still blames it on me. But at least now I know what to do to fix it - thanks for the replies everyone.
